name: SizeFinderRuler
job: A draggable ruler where the visitor slides to their measurement (foot length, chest, ring) and the recommended size lights up with a note
visitor_action: drag the ruler or use arrow keys; tap a tick
mobile: horizontal drag ruler with big readout
motion: ruler scrolls with momentum and snaps to ticks, size badge swaps with a small pop (reduced-motion: no momentum, instant badge)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Drafting desk: warm maple ruler strip, black engraved ticks, citrus-yellow indicator needle, clean paper-white readout
notes: Never rendered by the builder (render and craft deferred to QA). Maple grain and paper texture are CSS-embedded SVG noise, so tune their strength on first look. Needle uses a fixed citrus-on-dark pairing: a dark accent colour would lose contrast on the mat.
